title: Handwritten debriefing notes with sketch of concentric ovals in a tall rectangular frame
description: Lined notepaper of pencil notes mentioning an eclipse, a GSFC picture, "bright airglow", "dark-adapted", "Rte 180, 385, cities Texas & New Mexico", "de-briefing operat." and "morale". Along the right side is a tall narrow rectangle containing a small set of concentric oval outlines. The lower corner of the page is torn away.
